takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **66%** of 110 plays (n=73); also Slot 34% (n=37).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **9.1 yd** downfield by the throw vs 11.2 for WRs (shallower) (n=110, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (66%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
